items.title: Rudolph Beaulieu Interview, 1961-05-31
items.q: Anon Matoie. Yeah. But some people call him Matoie.

ctx.x: It should be Val-to . start with the F and they pronounce it V too. Yeah. Like I'm thinking of a clarinetist up in Chicago, Valle de Vaux. Valle de Vaux. Well no I mean his last name though. Vaux, something they call Vaux and something Vaux. I think sometimes those names... Well look at this Scott,
it's not telling you about it. Anon Matoie. Yeah. But some people call him Matoie.

Yeah. Anon Matoie. Oh and we talked to his daughter and his widow too, they're still living, and we asked his daughter how to pronounce it and she said we call it Matoie. Yeah. Like it's spelled in English T-O-Y-E-R. Matoie. Like a toy. That's right.
